title: Domi L Probable NDE 7215
content: Following a car accident with my son, I fell into a coma. I was suffering from cranial trauma, immediate amnesia, open fractured anklebone, as well as trauma everywhere in the body. A gap of one month of my life is missing, yet at the time I seemed to speak normally with people, as I was told later. During that period, I had an NDE. I really spoke about it to a doctor, who belongs to the IANDS association, some three years ago. I didn't dare to speak about it, for fear of being considered crazy. To be able to talk about it liberated me from this 'secret'. I went into the tunnel of light. I had no body. I felt a well-being, as such that does not exist on earth. I had neither sentiment nor past. On the other side of the tunnel, I felt millions of presences, that also had no sentiments, but who were feeling neither bad nor good. They didn't know evil anymore. On the other hand, I didn't see any animals. Then I was stopped by the superior Power. The Power was telling me through telepathy that I was lacking something, and that I should protect it. I knew that I had to do what I was told, whether or not I wanted to do so. Otherwise, I could go no further. I had no choice but to follow what I was called upon to do. What I was missing was Faith. What I had to protect, I still don't know or I did it already without knowing. The feeling I had about this is; it is not we who choose what follows. One has to have good behavior on earth, and one should not commit suicide as our departure is being decided up there. I wasn't ready, and I lacked knowledge in spirituality. The feeling I had is that one should leave the souls of deceased people in peace. Some have other things to do up there. It's another form of life.

arrival.other_being_detail: “millions of presences” on the other side of the tunnel; later “stopped by the superior Power.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “On the other side of the tunnel, I felt millions of presences.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told telepathically by the “superior Power” that the experiencer was “lacking something” and “should protect it”; “Otherwise, I could go no further.”
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Telepathic instruction from the “superior Power”: what was missing was “Faith,” and the experiencer “should protect it.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: “millions of presences”; “superior Power”; “I had no body”; “well-being.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel experience followed by presences/realm and then being stopped by a “superior Power” communicating telepathically.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported absence of emotion: “I had neither sentiment nor past.” Presences also had “no sentiments” and “didn't know evil anymore.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I went into the tunnel of light.” “I had no body.” “I felt a well-being, as such that does not exist on earth.” “On the other side of the tunnel, I felt millions of presences.” “Then I was stopped by the superior Power.” “The Power was telling me through telepathy that I was lacking something, and that I should protect it.” “What I was missing was Faith.”
